issue_queue.note: issue_burst_bench (SQTT): a single wave issues ~16-20 VMEM / LDS instructions at 4 cycles each, then at the unit's acceptance rate; no hard in-flight limit up to 32 outstanding loads

kernel_overhead.tail_wave_rule: time = rounds x per-round time, rounds = ceil(ctas / (80 x ctas_per_cu)); measured steps exact to <0.3%

recurrence_step.model: ISA-level in-order issue simulation of one CTA (isa_sim.py) on the production loop body extracted from SQTT (sq_loop.py); costs: COST / LDS_OCC / TA_OCC / MMAC_FWD / LDS_WAVE / Q_WAVE in isa_sim.py, all from this library; per-instance memory input hbm_frac = unique HBM bytes / loaded bytes
